privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Privacy policy of the Soulwick website and game.
privacy.placeholderTitle: The privacy policy is being set up.

facts.offline: Single player runs entirely without a server. Unless you sign in inside the game, no game data leaves your machine.
facts.stored: If you later sign in inside the game (for guilds and leaderboards, both planned), the server stores only: a platform or device ID, your player name, your guild and run reports (mode, participants, room reached, duration, seed, game version).
facts.notStored: No real names and no payment data. E-mail addresses only if you write to us yourself, for example to have your account deleted without access to the game.
facts.website: This website sets no tracking and no advertising cookies. When you open it, the server briefly processes technically necessary data such as your IP address to deliver the page and protect it from abuse.
facts.deletion: You delete your account yourself, right away: in the game under Account, or <link>here on the website</link> with a deletion code from the game. This removes your player profile, your guild membership and your link to run reports.
